stormwell-story.name: Stormwell Archive story direction
stormwell-story.text: Forensic science fiction about evidence. Treat archival work as active physical and analytical labor: custody, recovery, decoding, emulation, calibration, provenance, version genealogy, uncertainty, and the distinction between raw observations and derived products. Stormwell Archive is a working research vessel, not a shrine. Preserve established Rex Fleet visual grammar without importing Thunderbreak's political-drama tone. Use clear causal sequential storytelling, natural acting, restrained interfaces, exact scripted dialogue, and minimal environmental text. Mystery tension should come from what the evidence can and cannot support, not from melodramatic conspiracy or supernatural archive symbolism.
